title: RiderJoined
description: Server to the host only (ADR 0007 section 2): a rider token's connection completed hello, the first time or again after it left; always the same rider id and nickname for one rider token.

rider.description: The rider's id: 8 random bytes, base64url without padding, given by the server at the join, never derived from the token or the nickname, the same for the token's whole life.

nickname.description: The rider's nickname, 1 to 24 characters with control characters removed by the server; always rendered as text, held in memory only, for the session.
